# Synthetic dashboard result

`synthetic-single-result.json` was regenerated by `tools/capture_single_fixture.py`
on 2026-10-07 from the public `run_simulation` service: SC, the first two
15-minute slots of the packaged case, MISOCP, storage enabled, 60-second solve
limit. It carries schema 1.26.0 / single-execution-v9 and real 30-minute evidence,
including the original hard energy task, retained joint certificates and
repriced feedback candidate selection.
It contains no customer measurements. It is a captured
transport fixture for result identity/UI tests, not a numerical reference oracle.
Tests clone it with a distinct generation time to identify a second completion.

Event-scope tests also construct an explicitly synthetic cluster transport projection
from this fixture: three-region metadata, two small aggregate time points and an
existing event. These values verify target selection and preservation of request/result
identity, not cluster physics or solver accuracy.

The 1.26.0 capture uses unified-single-v7 with joint nominal P/Q planning,
minute capability boundaries, finite-resolution zero-ceiling landing witnesses,
independent PCS backup recovery,
original-target priority, local allocation trials and feedback participation
fields. It is a fresh service run, not an upgrade of historical certificates.
Historical v4 full-day validation remains at schema 1.22.0. Physical limits and the original task
remain explicit; failed construction is not a physical infeasibility proof.
